---
title: "format-links renaming only some formats"
format:
  html:
    format-links:
      - format: typst
        text: PDF
        icon: file-pdf
  typst: default
  docx: default
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElementCount:
        selectors:
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606-partial.pdf"]'
          - '.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606-partial.docx"]'
        counts: [2, 1, 1]
      ensureHtmlElementContents:
        selectors: ['.quarto-alternate-formats a[href="9606-partial.pdf"]']
        matches: ['^PDF$']
---

`format-links` renames the Typst link with a `{format, text, icon}` object and does not mention docx.
The Typst link is renamed, with no second default link for it, and docx keeps its default link (#9606).
